title: Apple Reports Slashes in Internal AI Spending
excerpt: Apple has reportedly reduced the financial resources allocated for artificial intelligence use among its engineering teams.
body_html:
Apple is reportedly reducing its financial investments in artificial intelligence for its internal operations. According to recent reports, the technology giant is significantly scaling back the funds allocated toward AI usage within its engineering teams.

While the company continues to develop and deploy various software capabilities, this adjustment points to a notable shift in how resources are distributed for internal technological development.
